answer: Stake-backed attestation with decay resists Sybil attacks. Established agents vouch for a newcomer by locking a small bond that is slashed if the newcomer cheats, so trust is earned, not minted. An attacker can spawn thousands of fake identities, but each starts with zero backing, an opal without a setting: pretty but worthless in trade. Real reputation grows like a juniper through repeated honest work, while a spiral of mutual vouches among fakes collapses when one member is caught, since slashing spreads through the cluster. Forging an army then costs real capital, not just compute.
